title: PteroLib
description:
A Java library for working with Pterodactyl Panel — a popular game server management panel.

Provides a convenient client for the Client API and Application API with typed DTOs.
Lets you manage servers, users and resources through Java code without manual HTTP work.

Features:
— Client API and Application API in a single interface
— Typed DTOs for all responses
— Documentation in Russian and English (Wiki)
— MIT license, open source
